world.geography: Australia (a fictional national professional institute of building certifiers)
world.org_type: professional institute running the accreditation examination for building certifiers

driver: Each unit answers a few of several alternative items it chooses itself, and the items differ in difficulty while the units choosing each differ in standing, so an item's mean outcome mixes its difficulty with its choosers' standing; the difficulty for the whole population is read by comparing the same units across the items they chose, and correcting by the mean outcome leaves the hardest and the easiest items well short of their difficulty.
driver_concrete: The November 2026 paper's new fire safety question was chosen mostly by the stronger candidates and the plain consent conditions question by the weaker, so the fire question's mean mark sits mid-pack while its answerers scored 3.4 marks less on it than on their other answers; read on the same candidates across the questions they chose, the fire question is the hardest (+3) and the consent question the easiest (-3), where the means give +1 and -1 and pass 21 more candidates.
stump: A competent analyst sets each question's mean mark among those who answered it against the paper's mean, moves the fire safety question by +1 and the consent conditions question by -1, and files 422 passes where regulation 14 gives 401; the step that lands it there is reading a question's mean as its difficulty when the candidates who chose it are not the sitting.

lineage.architecture: v1 (a regional council of governments splitting its 2027 weatherization fund across fourteen member counties by working families with children claiming the earned income credit, from IRS ZIP-code tables)
lineage.fate: re-rooted 2026-11-01 at the Batch 3 queue reset (shipped 2026-10-20 with no portal result; world closed, one architecture per world)
lineage.driver: A subtotal of one kind of member inside each area's published total is never published, but each area's total comes with a paired amount and the kinds carry known and very different average amounts, so an area's own count and amount fix its mix; applying the region-wide share of the kind to every area misplaces the subtotal wherever an area's mix departs from the region's, and a cap that binds only on the overstated area moves every other share.
lineage.driver_concrete: The council allocates by earned income credit returns with qualifying children, which the IRS ZIP-code tables do not split; in the lowest AGI class, the only one where childless workers claim, each county's claims count and credit amount together fix how many are families, because a childless worker's credit averages a few hundred dollars against several thousand for a family; the statewide share overstates the seat county, whose many young childless workers pull its average credit down, and caps it at 12 per cent instead of leaving it below the cap.
lineage.stump: The default path applies the statewide share of claimants with children in each AGI class to every county's credit claims and caps the seat county at 12 per cent, because it never asks what each county's own credit amounts say about its mix of families and childless workers.

notes: Client domain education-learning-sciences, task type item-response-theory-test-equating (ETL, DD): putting optional questions on one scale is equating within a paper. stump_strategy population_selection: each question's answerers are a population selected on standing, and the decisive move reads the question's difficulty for the whole sitting rather than for its choosers. Decisive generator G6 (the composition of each question's answerers differs from the sitting's), with G14 (the choosers' mean does not carry to the cohort) and G17 (each move asserted mid-way between whole marks). gate_g etl_conformance: the deliverable is the results file conformed to Regulation 14.
